recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-5781 unless a future work group decision revisits the current additional-binding model.
issue_request: FHIR-5781 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that ElementDefinition.binding conformance and extensibility be rationalized to one element, with possible extension handling for edge-case binding variations.
initial_application: FHIR-5781 comments point to FHIR-3187 and record svn 4300 for that change. Git-svn commit f45d3ec3d14c29dee23b1c9f5f7c4b18d99cdf7c corresponds to build@4300 and added ElementDefinition.binding.strength while inactivating the old isExtensible/conformance rows and updating terminology prose.
additional_context: FHIR-3187 supplies the detailed Vocab motion for one strength element with required, extensible, preferred, and example codes. Later core source added ElementDefinition.binding.additional and descriptive/additional binding purposes; current terminology prose says maximum/minimum additional bindings replace the old max/min value-set extensions. The Extension Pack retains retired/deprecated maxValueSet and minValueSet definitions pointing to additionalBinding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active build-scope source is already correct: ElementDefinition is active/normative in fhir.ini, ElementDefinition.binding.strength is the single active control, and no active binding.conformance or binding.extensibility source remains.
